description: WYSIWYG renderer of ONE email block on the editor canvas (Fáze 9A): an approximation of the MJML output built from the model values — text as sanitized inline HTML with token chips, a button as a pill with its background/radius/alignment, an image as an with src/alt/width, divider, spacer, table with a header row and linked cells, social icons, navbar links, hero with a background image and nested content, carousel as its first image plus the count, accordion titles, and a wrapper/group as a frame holding its nested sections/columns. The authoritative output stays the server preview (IEmailPreviewRenderer). The renderer owns its own re-render decision (ShouldRender over the block's rendered-data signature), so a property change repaints one block instead of the document. Untrusted content: block text goes through IHtmlContentSanitizer and loses every attribute, an mj-raw block is NEVER rendered as markup, no link is navigable (a click selects the block), and every URL passes EmailUrlPolicy. Set CanvasImageLoading=Placeholder to issue no image request at all.

parameters.name: CanvasImageLoading
parameters.description: Whether the remote images of the block may be requested by the author's browser. Defaults to Load; Placeholder paints a framed alt-text placeholder and issues no request (privacy / tracking protection).

parameters.name: Nested
parameters.description: Whether the block is drawn INSIDE another block's frame (a wrapper, a hero, a group) instead of as a canvas item. Nested blocks are content: they carry no canvas selector and no drag/selection target.
